How it works:

The Dry-Down System: Medical Treatment That Becomes a Powder Barrier

Clean & Dry

Gently clean the affected skin fold with mild soap and lukewarm water. Pat the skin dry thoroughly - you can use a hair dryer on cool air to ensure the fold is completely dry before application.

Apply & Eliminate

Apply a thin layer of cream to the affected area and surrounding skin. The medicinal active ingredients immediately begin to kill yeast and bacteria, while the witch hazel makes the skin surface tight and dry. Make sure you cover the entire fold - a small amount goes a long way. Wash your hands after application.

See Transformation & Protection

Within minutes, you will feel the cream transform from a light application to a smooth, dry protective layer. The burning sensation disappears almost immediately. The silica-tapioca matrix creates an invisible powder barrier that absorbs moisture all day long, while the microencapsulated tea tree oil slowly releases antimicrobial protection. For fastest results, use the cream 2 times per day. Dermatologists recommend continuing to use it 2 to 3 times a week as a preventative measure after the rash has cleared to prevent recurrence.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How does BioEdge™ BioHeal Relief Cream work in treating skin fold rashes?

The cream uses a combination of antifungal, antibacterial and moisture-regulating ingredients to address the cause of skin fold rashes. It eliminates yeast and bacteria at a cellular level and turns into a protective powder-like barrier that keeps the area dry and comfortable.

Is the cream safe for daily use?

Yes, the cream is dermatologically tested and hypoallergenic, making it safe for daily use. It is gentle enough to be used on all skin folds, and many users continue to use it 2 to 3 times per week as a preventative measure.

How quickly will I notice results after using the cream?

Most users report noticeable improvement within 24 hours, with symptoms such as burning, itching and odour reducing almost immediately after application. Complete healing may take a few days depending on the severity.

Can I use this cream if I have sensitive or damaged skin?

Absolutely. The formula is designed to be gentle and will not cause pain or burning, even on raw or damaged skin. It is safe for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

Does this cream leave a greasy residue?

No, the cream dries to a smooth, non-greasy, powder-like finish that stays dry all day. It is specially formulated to prevent the discomfort that greasy creams, which trap moisture and aggravate rashes, can cause.
